name: Flash Intro Site
summary: A full-window site built as vector animation: a loading bar, a 'skip intro' link, tiny pixel type, custom cursors, sound and transitions between sections. Macromedia Flash made it possible.

philosophy.core_thesis: A site is a performance: control every pixel and every second, and make the visitor wait for it.
design_principles: Fill the full window with one stage and centre a fixed area of 800px by 600px or 1000px by 600px.
Open with a loading bar of 1px to 4px and a counter from 0% to 100%, then a 5 to 20 second intro.
Put a 'skip intro' link of 11px in the lower corner, visible from the first frame.
Set navigation in pixel type of 8px to 10px in upper case, with 0.1em tracking, and place it on a free path.
Move each section in by tween: slide 40px to 120px with an ease-out over 400ms to 800ms.
Use one accent (#FF6600) on a dark ground (#111111) and keep the rest in grey tones.
Follow the pointer: an element trails the cursor at 0.1 to 0.2 easing.
anti_patterns: Instant static pages with no intro
Standard text navigation in a bar
Long blocks of readable body text
Native scroll with no scene change
Plain system fonts at 16px for all text

layout.grid_mechanics: A fixed stage of 800px to 1000px wide on a centred 12-column grid with 20px gutters; each scene replaces the last.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 50% of the stage is empty ground; the spacing scale is 10, 20 and 40px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred stage; navigation and credits at the edges; text blocks flush left at 10px to 12px.
layout.container_geometry: Hairline rectangles of 1px, circles and thin lines; the radius is 0px to 2px.

font_pairings.note: Oswald is a tall condensed display; Silkscreen is an open pixel face for the tiny navigation.
Jost is an open geometric sans in the Futura line, with a mono text face.
A narrow display with a pixel label face.

hierarchy_rules: Use 8px to 10px pixel type for navigation and 11px for body text.
Use one large word of 48px to 96px per scene as the title.
Use the accent colour for the active item only.
Use upper case for navigation and lower case for body text.

color.palette_structure: A dark or white stage, grey tones and one saturated accent; one more cool tone for lines.
color.contrast_rules: Light text on stage black is 16:1; muted grey on black is 6.5:1; orange on black is 6.8:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat vector fills, thin lines and one soft glow; no photographic texture.
color.light_and_shadow: Light comes from an accent glow of 8px to 20px on one element; a hard 1px highlight line on panels.

materiality.surface_simulation: A vector screen: crisp fills and hairlines on a dark stage, with a little bitmap texture.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px line in grey (#444444); a 1px accent line for the active state.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A blur of 4px to 12px in motion trails; no cast shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin 1px vector icons at 16px to 24px, arrows, crosses and circles, with a pixel cursor.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Vector figures, cut-out photos, abstract line art, particle sprays and short looped clips.

motion.transition_physics: Scenes enter by tween: 40px to 120px slides over 400ms to 800ms with ease-out; trails follow the cursor; the intro runs 5s to 20s.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover moves the item 4px, turns it orange and plays a click sound; active state fades the stage to the next scene.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels invited into a stylish show, and also sometimes feels kept waiting.

avoid_when: The page needs speed, search and indexing.
Mobile and keyboard access are the main routes.

modifiers.how: Remove the intro and the loading bar; keep the dark ground and one accent.
Replace the hairlines with glossy buttons and a reflection under the logo.
Remove the animation and show the raw HTML and the defaults.

pack.why: Pixel icons match the tiny pixel navigation of a Flash site.

ground.why: The ground is a dark stage with faint light rays, like the opening scene of a Flash intro.
